ISSUE_KIND: road_damage
ISSUE: Sinkhole in the road
DETAILS: The photo shows a large sinkhole where a section of the road pavement has collapsed, exposing a deep hole with a wooden structure and some debris inside. The user note provides no additional details.
ORGANIZATION: Prince George's County Department of Public Works & Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Office of Highway Maintenance
WHY: The location is an unincorporated area in Prince George's County, so the local government is the county. The Prince George's County Department of Public Works & Transportation is responsible for repairing roads and sinkholes on county-maintained residential streets like this one.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "As part of the Prince George's County Roadway Preservation Program, maintenance includes the repair of sinkholes and potholes, shoulder repair, removal and replacement of concrete curb and gutter, sidewalks, driveway aprons, the installation of underdrains, the installation and/or upgrade of handicapped access ramps per ADA standards and the repair/resurfacing of the roadway pavement."
